purpose: This silver table is a cleaned airline carrier reference set, pairing each IATA carrier code with its full legal carrier name, intended to be joined with flight fact tables to enrich records with readable carrier identity.
usage: Join downstream flight tables on the carrier column, which is the declared grain, to pull in carrier_name; since duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 and null_rate is 0.0 on both columns, no additional null-filtering or dedupe logic is required by consumers.
limitations: The profile covers only 16 rows (one per carrier observed at capture time), so carriers introduced after this snapshot will be absent until the bronze source is re-profiled; the zero duplicate_row_rate and zero null_rate reflect this single capture and were not evaluated across multiple extraction cycles.
